newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Nuplex to buy Plaster Systems for NZ$6.5m.
newsitem.headline: Nuplex to buy Plaster Systems for NZ$6.5m.

text.p: Nuplex Industries Ltd said on Thursday it was acquiring the total shareholding in Auckland-based Plaster Systems Ltd for NZ$6.5 million cash.
Nuplex's directors said they expected that in the first full year of ownership the new business would achieve earnings before interest and tax of NZ$1.9 million.
Plaster Systems, established in 1987, operates from its freehold property in Glenfield, Auckland.
Nuplex said Plaster Systems was a leading manufacturer of a wide range of proprietary exterior thin-coat plaster systems for residential and commercial use by the building industry.
Plaster Systems sells most of its products through a network of licensed applicators. Its product range includes Insulclad, an insulating system.
"This acquisition continues the policy of growing our core businesses through expansion of the product base," Nuplex's directors said.
The agreement to purchase the company will be settled on October 31. Plaster Systems' staff of nearly 20 will be retained by Nuplex. -- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
